basics.name: Omniah Arafah
basics.label: Aspiring Data Scientist | Turning Raw Data into Meaningful, Real-World Impact
basics.tagline: Turning data into ethical, impact-driven solutions that honor faith and improve lives.
basics.summary: I am a final-year Statistics student at Alexandria University with a minor in Computer Science, and I am on my way to becoming a data scientist. I chose this path for three honest reasons. First, data science gives me the tools to solve real-world problems that align with my personal mission — to use technology in ways that are ethical, community-driven, and rooted in my Islamic values. Second, it is a field that rewards both analytical depth and creativity, and it offers a genuinely rewarding career. Third, my natural curiosity for data, combined with a strong academic foundation in statistics, makes this the field where I feel most at home. I build predictive models, design interactive dashboards, and engineer data pipelines — always with the aim of making something that actually matters. I am currently looking for internship or junior analyst opportunities where I can grow, contribute, and do work I am proud of.
basics.mission: To live life intentionally as a devoted believer, utilizing my advanced data science and technical skills to empower communities, support ethical AI development, and create meaningful, faith-driven impact within the Islamic community and beyond.

passions: Volunteering time and technical strategy with charity associations.

elevatorPitch:
Hi, I’m Omniah Arafah.

I am a final-year Statistics student at Alexandria University with a minor in Computer Science. My academic work is deeply rooted in high-stakes data projects, including developing a heart disease prediction model that achieved a 92.9% recall rate and building automated pipelines to process hundreds of thousands of IoT data points for environmental analysis.

I specialize in transforming raw data into insights using Python, SQL, and Power BI.

What makes me stand out is my dual focus: I have the technical rigor of a statistician and the practical mindset of a business analyst. I don’t just deliver numbers; I deliver the story behind them.

I help organizations eliminate guesswork by creating clear, interactive dashboards and predictive models. My goal is to make your day-to-day operations easier by identifying client retention patterns and automating the reporting processes that usually take your team hours to complete.

I am currently looking for opportunities to join a forward-thinking team as a Junior Data Analyst. If you are looking for someone who can hit the ground running with data modeling and visualization, I would love to connect and show you my portfolio.

I’m ready to help you turn your data into a competitive advantage, and I’d be delighted to discuss how my skills can support your upcoming projects.

projects.name: Heart Disease Prediction Model
projects.description: Built a machine learning model to help identify patients at risk of heart disease. The project focused on reducing missed diagnoses by prioritizing recall, which is critical in healthcare settings. I handled data cleaning, feature selection, model training, and evaluation using Python.

projects.name: Air Quality Forecasting & Analysis in Dar es Salaam
projects.achievement: MAE: 3.15 µg/m³ | Processed 346k+ IoT data points
projects.description: Engineered a data pipeline to clean and prepare 3 months of IoT sensor data (346k+ entries) for time series analysis. Developed and tuned an ARIMA model to forecast PM2.5 levels, implementing walk-forward validation.

projects.name: Global Chocolate Sales Analysis & Predictive Modeling
projects.achievement: R-squared: 1.00 | Identified Gender-Time Matrix for expansion
projects.description: Conducted comprehensive data analysis for a global chocolate retailer to identify key drivers of regional sales. Performed data cleaning on a messy dataset and developed a Linear Regression model achieving R-squared of 1.00.

projects.name: Chinook Music Store: SQL-Driven Business Intelligence
projects.achievement: Identified Top 3 Revenue-Generating Genres | Optimized Inventory Strategy
projects.description: Leveraged SQL Server and Python to perform deep-dive analysis of a digital music store's relational database. Developed complex SQL queries to extract insights across sales performance, customer demographics, and inventory.

projects.name: Egyptian Logistics & Weather Impact Dashboard
projects.achievement: Identified main delay causes | Visualized performance across 6+ regions
projects.description: Designed an interactive Power BI dashboard to help logistics teams track delivery delays and performance across Egyptian cities. The dashboard highlights late shipments, delay reasons, and weather impact to support faster decision-making.

projects.name: COVID-19 Global Healthcare Insights Dashboard
projects.description: Developed an interactive Power BI dashboard to visualize COVID-19 progression globally. Integrated multi-source data to track cases, mortality rates, and recovery trends with geographical mapping.

projects.name: Employee Wellbeing & Lifestyle Performance Analysis
projects.achievement: Identified 66.7 Avg WLB Score | Segmented 15k+ records
projects.description: Conducted statistical analysis on 15,000+ responses to study personal wellbeing and lifestyle factors. Engineered a custom 'Work-Life Balance' score and used Excel for correlation analysis.
